summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a London Stock Exchange notification of admission of further securities to trading under PRM 1.6.4R of the UK Public Offers and Admissions to Trading Regulations 2024. The notice covers 11,948 new ordinary shares of $0.25 each (ISIN GB0009895292), issued between 1 October and 31 October 2026 under employee share schemes and admitted via an existing block admission dated 29 January 2021. Post-admission total shares in issue are 1,551,065,237, fully fungible with existing ordinary shares; no prospectus was required. No deal terms, no special-situation event, no arbitrage angle.
